summary.text: Brandon Washington is an independent write-in candidate for the Tennessee House of Representatives, District 93, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists him as an activist.

paragraphs.text: Brandon Washington earned a high school diploma from Middle College High School, and Ballotpedia lists his career experience as activism.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a Memphis native and foster care advocate who entered foster care at 15, and said he is a student at the University of Memphis.

He lost the Democratic primary for the Shelby County Board of Commissioners, District 10, on May 5, 2026, and in 2023 he lost the general election for Memphis City Council Super District 9, Position 2, to incumbent J. Ford Canale.
